links.outcome: Readability of LLM diabetic foot patient information against predefined readability targets
links.effect: No response met all predefined readability targets; DeepSeek-V4 had the lowest grade-level scores and highest FRES, but readability was judged inadequate overall.
links.quote: No response met all predefined readability targets.

links.outcome: Visible transparency features (JAMA benchmark) in LLM responses
links.effect: Visible transparency-related scores remained low across models; Grok 4.3 had the highest observed JAMA-based score.
links.quote: Visible transparency-related scores remained low across models.

unlisted_practices: Domain- and source-balanced prompt framework for benchmarking public-interface LLM patient information

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the quality, readability, transparency, and safety flags of multiple public-interface LLMs generating patient-facing diabetic foot information using a standardized prompt set, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
